text:
Riley G: Hi team! First day here — Riley G (she/her). Quick q: where do people usually eat around the office and who should I ping for laptop/setup? Also fun fact: I have a sourdough starter named 'Ada'.

Aisha — People Ops: Welcome Riley!! :tada: I'll DM you the onboarding checklist and swag form. For laptop, ping @Tom (Eng) — he'll sort hardware. Lunch-wise the team usually does ramen on Wed and tacos on Fri.

Tom (Eng): Hey Riley, congrats! I'll open a ticket for laptop + VPN access. Can you fill this short form: http://intra/redwood-laptop-request ? Also let me know if you prefer M1 vs A100 for dev work.

Lina (DevEx): Hi Riley! I'm Lina from DevEx. Once your laptop arrives, enroll in MDM with this command in the terminal:
```
curl -fsSL https://mdm.redwood.local/enroll | sudo bash
```
And add your SSH pubkey to Git (Settings > SSH Keys) — paste into https://git.redwood/keys. If you need help generating a key, say the word.

DevEx Bot: DevEx Bot: New user provisioning will auto-run ~10 minutes after a ticket is created. You'll get an email when the device profile is applied.

Tom (Eng): Also — if you hit VPN routing issues, ping #eng-oncall. We use asdf for language runtimes; dotfiles and recommended packages are at git.redwood/dotfiles.

Aisha — People Ops: :wave: Also let us know t-shirt size and whether you want a plant-friendly desk or standing desk. Quick onboarding fun question: what's your favorite hacky snack? We'll bring something for your first week.

Riley G: Thanks all!! T-shirt M, standing desk is fine. Favorite snack = salted pistachios. Down for ramen Wednesday — where do folks usually meet?

Lina (DevEx): Meet in the lobby at 12:15, someone will ping in #lunch-plans. If you'd like a 30m intro 1:1, I can book one for tomorrow afternoon.

Tom (Eng): Ticket created: #12345 — provisioning started. I'll DM you once the laptop ships to your address.

Riley G: Amazing, appreciate the warm welcome :heart: Also btw I brought a tiny cactus named 'Byte' if anyone wants to see pics.

Aisha — People Ops: Yay cactus pics pls. See you at 12:15!
